articles.title: The Frame: how to build a knowledge layer for what your company knows about its users
articles.summary: The Frame replaces static research repositories by organizing verified user evidence around standing questions. Its five-part architecture (claims, intake, structure, upkeep, and access) combines AI drafting with human review to deliver real-time user insights.

articles.title: What Product Strategy Does
articles.summary: Product strategy is an ongoing, iterative process rather than a static artifact. Drawing on PlanGrid and Wardley Mapping, the author shows how keeping game, gameplay, and players in constant conversation establishes clear orientation, smooth operations, and sustainable traction.

articles.title: When Building Gets Easier, Decisions Get Harder
articles.summary: As AI accelerates software development, product managers face bigger challenges in evaluating impact and removing unnecessary features. Drawing on experiences at Livesport, this article shows how faster building shifts focus to feature elimination and product coherence.

articles.title: How Figma's PMs actually use AI every day (42 minute video)
articles.summary: PM OS is a collection of 31 AI skills built on Claude Code to streamline product management work at Figma. The system automates context gathering, Slack updates, artifact creation, and experiment generation.

articles.title: How to build a deployment path for an AI product manager
articles.summary: Organizations need streamlined, collaborative deployment paths so non-engineer builders can safely deploy AI products. Engineering teams should automate compliance, while product managers drive hypotheses and feedback under strict SLAs to process changes rapidly.

articles.title: How to scope a SaaS project you can afford to finish
articles.summary: Effective SaaS project scoping requires defining core problems, reusing existing components, and aligning budgets before committing to pricing. Teams can set reliable estimates and complete projects affordably by leveraging existing assets and making strategic feature tradeoffs.

articles.title: Our organizations are being DDoSed from the inside
articles.summary: Companies face an internal denial-of-service dynamic as high-velocity team output and AI agents outpace leadership's review capacity. Output is often mistaken for value, so leaders must clarify intent upfront and establish deliberate release gating to stay aligned.

articles.title: The most critical qualities for PMs
articles.summary: Product management roles are shifting away from process optimization and prioritization theater.

articles.title: Making AI measurable
articles.summary: Measuring AI ROI requires linking initiatives to concrete business metrics rather than technical indicators or self-reported productivity.
